# AI Study Workflow

This repository uses AI as a **study partner**, not only as a code generator.

## Modes

- `study.prompt.md` — guided learning
- `quiz.prompt.md` — active recall
- `debug.prompt.md` — guided debugging
- `review.prompt.md` — pedagogical code review
- `interview.prompt.md` — technical interview simulation

The persistent instructions in `copilot-instructions.md` apply the same learning philosophy across the repository.

## Learning loop

```text
WHY
 ↓
MENTAL MODEL
 ↓
EXAMPLE
 ↓
PREDICTION
 ↓
EXPERIMENT
 ↓
PRACTICE
 ↓
PRODUCTION APPLICATION
```

The important rule is: **do not optimize for the amount of code produced; optimize for independent reasoning.**
